disclosures: The denominator is every non-forfeited selection in each terminal official NHL draft ledger, including players with zero NHL games.
Skater and goalie appearances join by official draft year and overall pick; player names are not used for identity resolution.
Outcomes include regular-season NHL games in the first fixed number of seasons beginning with the draft year.
69 byte-identical duplicate season rows were collapsed before aggregation.

curve.method: mature-cohort fixed-horizon outcomes with weighted monotone regression
disclosures: Expected pick value does not predict the identity or ceiling of the eventual selection.
Earlier picks are constrained to retain at least the expected value of later picks; uncertainty remains visible.
